trade_frequency.rule: Do not add trades to hit a daily rupee target.
trade_frequency.paper14k_design: One signal family per book per session; no-trade days are valid.
trade_frequency.live_4_nov: Nifty took a second ticket after a scratch (no cooldown). Both lost.

evidence.1: Matches the pre-registered Paper 14k and 3-year grids (one trade/day). Still no validated edge.
evidence.2: Doubles charges and the chance of a second scratch. 4 Nov Nifty: −₹221 then −₹217.
evidence.3: No study in this repo supports three independent +EV entries per name per day.
evidence.4: Overtrading. Cost stack (₹54–₹122 RT plus spread) dominates any unvalidated tick edge.
evidence.5: Rejected. Same as 4 with worse cost drag.
evidence.gt5: Rejected. Intraday options buying at this size is a lottery on direction, not a volume business.

trade_frequency.optimal_per_instrument: 0 or 1. A no-trade day is allowed and preferred when spread, DTE, or structure fail the filters.
trade_frequency.time_of_day: Paper 14k: Nifty first entry 10:15, Bank/Sensex 09:45, flat 15:15. Crude energy session 09:00–23:30 IST; overnight gap is a different market.
trade_frequency.losing_day_probability: UNSUPPORTED as a forecast. Modelled Paper 14k green-day rates were ~31–42% on TEST — that is not a live probability.

answers.capital_needed: For paper observation of one Nifty lot: recommended ₹23,140 (ATM cash ₹11,570 + 100% reserve) as of 4 Nov 2026 13:28 IST. For live deployment: do not fund. No validated edge.
answers.instruments: Paper-only: NIFTY (first) or CRUDEOILM (low cash). Not a live shortlist.
answers.how_many: One. Two only if the second is a different driver (crude vs index) and still paper. Three or more is correlated size, not diversification.
answers.lots: One lot. Never two. Never average down. Never martingale.
answers.trades_per_day: Zero or one per instrument. No-trade days allowed.
answers.daily_expectancy: Not supported. Modelled figures are not live-quote validated. 4 Nov exact blotter: −₹1,042 on four tickets.
answers.monthly_expectancy: Not supported. Do not annualise a non-edge.
answers.avoid: BANKEX (untradeable book). CRUDEOIL standard as a first book. Stacking NIFTY+BANKNIFTY+SENSEX. Any futures book as a substitute for an options edge.
answers.max_daily_loss: Paper desk ₹420/book. Research recommendation: 2% of allocated capital, never more than 25% of the premium on the open lot, then stand down.
answers.validated_strategy: NONE. NO VALIDATED EDGE — DO NOT DEPLOY LIVE CAPITAL.
